A 69-year-old woman preparing for a 3-week trip to Mozambique seeks travel advice. After updating
her vaccinations, you discuss malaria prophylaxis and decide on doxycycline, with the first dose to be
taken 2 days before her arrival in Mozambique. For how long should this patient continue taking
doxycycline after departing from Mozambique? Answer Choices: (A) Continue for another 72 hours
after return (B) Continue for another 10 days after return (C) Continue for another 5 days after return
(D) Continue for another one week after return (E) Continue for another 3 weeks after return (F)
Continue for another 6 weeks after return (G) Continue for another 8 weeks after return (H) Continue
for another 4 weeks after return (I) Stop immediately upon return (J) Discontinue immediately upon
return
 A. Continue for another 6 weeks after return
B. Continue for another one week after return
C. Continue for another 8 weeks after return
D. Continue for another 72 hours after return
E. Continue for another 3 weeks after return
F. Stop immediately upon return
G. Continue for another 5 days after return
H. Discontinue immediately upon return
I. Continue for another 4 weeks after return
J. Continue for another 10 days after return
